identity.description: An attacker uses WMI and PsExec to perform SMB brute force attacks against multiple hosts, triggering abnormal SMB activity detection. Cortex should detect this behavior through network connections and process execution patterns.

payload.code:
powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "[System.Net.Dns]::GetHostEntry('192.0.2.10')"
net use \\192.0.2.10\IPC$ /user:Administrator "password123"
net use \\192.0.2.11\IPC$ /user:Administrator "password123"
net use \\192.0.2.12\IPC$ /user:Administrator "password123"

biocs.name: Abnormal SMB activity to multiple hosts
biocs.description: Detection of multiple SMB connections to different hosts within a short time window
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter dst_port = 445
| filter action_remote_ip in ('192.0.2.10', '192.0.2.11', '192.0.2.12')
| comp count() as cnt by action_remote_ip
| comp count() as cnt by agent_hostname > 3

abiocs.name: Multiple SMB connections to different hosts
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation showing multiple distinct SMB connection attempts to different hosts in rapid succession
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter dst_port = 445
| filter action_remote_ip in ('192.0.2.10', '192.0.2.11', '192.0.2.12')
| comp count() as cnt by agent_hostname, action_remote_ip
| comp count() as cnt by agent_hostname > 3
